notes.title: Update 1.1.3!
notes.content:
Updates: 
[olist]
 Added a reward for signing up to the newsletter. 
 Improved opening workshop item pages after creation or updating to wait for the creation/updating to be complete. 
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 1.1.2!
notes.content:
Updates: 
[olist]
 Added and implemented an Endless Mode High Scores leaderboard. 
 Optimized the game a bit. 
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 1.1.1!
notes.content:
Updates: 
[olist]
 Tweaked the main menu. 
 Added help buttons in the Twitch settings and workshop menus that take you to their respective guides. 
[/olist] 

Bug Fixes: 
[olist]
 Fixed a bug with all of the bosses where their normal textures wouldn't load. 
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0!
notes.content:
Updates: 
[olist]
 Added 2 new areas. 4 levels, 2 new enemies, and a boss fight for each. The new areas are located after the third boss fight. 
 Added loading screens. 
 Made the health pickups give you full health instead of just some health. 
 Changed the Workshop menu layout. 
 Added a button in the Workshop menu to deselect all packs. 
 Made it so that your Workshop packs now also affect the images of characters in the menus. 
 Tweaked how many coins each enemy drops when it is killed. 
 Re-enabled the social media icons. 
 Changed the difficulty options from saying easy and hard to saying Roguelike and Roguelite which are more accurate. 
 Tweaked the Twitch integration health effects. 
[/olist]

Bug Fixes: 
[olist]
 Fixed a bug with the power-up that increases your size that made it permanent. 
 Fixed a bug with the power-up timer displays where they would also show decimals instead of just full seconds. 
 Fixed a bug with the power-up that increases the amount of damage your bullets do where the more bullets there are, the faster the power-up would go away. 
 Fixed a bug with the enemy AI that would cause them to sometimes jitter. 
 Fixed a bug with the power-ups where if you were to pick up more than 1 of the same type, then only the first one would count. 
 Fixed a bug where a power-up could spawn on top of the exit. Making it unreachable. 
 Fixed a bug with speedrun mode where coins would persist between speedrun attempts. 
 Fixed a bug with the options menu where a button wouldn't get disabled properly. 
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 1.0.3!
notes.content:
Updates: 
[olist]
 Massively improved the enemy AI. 
 Made the tutorial button not appear if it's your first time playing. 
 Made it so that you now regenerate health back up to 25%. After that, you need to find health or get to the next level to get more health back. 
 Improved the workshop integration by making it support you being subscribed to multiple items at any given moment. It also now supports you being able to create and update your own workshop items without needing to clear out any and all other items first. It's now also a little easier to update your workshop items and you can now work on multiple workshop items at once. 
[/olist]

Bug Fixes: 
[olist]
 Fixed a bug with Steam stats where they wouldn't update properly. 
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2!
notes.content:
Updates: 
[olist]
 Made it so that the Twitch password is hidden like how a password is hidden on any login screen. 
 Made it so that if the Twitch streamer forgets to add the "oauth:" part of the password, it adds it for them. 
 Changed all character and power-up hitboxes from squares to circles. 
 Made the bullets that bosses shoot three times bigger. 
 Made it so that the "Are You Sure" screen also appears when going back to the main menu and not just if you are resetting. 
 Spaced out the different parts of the Steam Workshop menu. 
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1!
notes.content:
Updates: 
[olist]
 Gave all buttons a background image so they can easily be identified from just text. 
 Added a timer next to each power-up so the player knows how much time is left for each power-up. 
 Made the reset button in the pause menu accident-proof by adding a confirmation screen that appears first. 
 Made it so that you can now use the power-ups shop in endless mode too. 
 Made it easier for players to tell where they are getting hit from, made it easier to avoid enemy attacks, and nerfed the first and last boss fights by making all bullets larger and slower. 
[/olist]

Bug Fixes: 
[olist]
 Fixed a bug with endless mode where the background music wouldn't play. 
[/olist]
